name: 8 Coil Shakti two-phase: hippocampus both sides, then amygdala left
origin: Todd Murphy (8 Coil Shakti software); signal templates licensed from Persinger & Koren
summary: One of Todd Murphy's interhemispheric 'as seen on TV' two-phase sessions for the 8 Coil Shakti: the hippocampal 'LTP' signal over both temporal lobes for 20 min, then amygdala burst-firing over the left temporal lobe for 20 min (the 40-min run most users prefer, Murphy says). Murphy states that the amygdala signal on the left in phase 2 gives emotional or positive after-effects.
notes: Coils as in the photos on the vendor's output pages for the left-ending sessions: six on the left and two on the right ('The left side has four coils from the left channel, and two coils from the right channel. The right side has two coils from the right stereo channel.'). The four left-channel coils form a cross over the left temporal lobe (FT7 front, C5 top, TP7 back, T9 bottom; CH1-4); the two right-channel coils on the left sit inside that cross, above-front and below-back of its centre (FTT7h and TTP9h; CH5-6), and the two on the right form the same diagonal pair over the right temporal lobe (FTT8h and TTP10h; CH7-8). The 10-5 sites are read from the photos and are an inference. Phase 1 (20 min) drives the four right-channel coils together (the right channel over both sides); phase 2 (20 min, abrupt switch) drives the four left-channel coils (the left channel over the left side only). There is no rotation, as on the two-channel Shakti. Polarity as in the photos ('Note the positions of the positive and negative coils carefully'): the left cross has its top and front coils - (C5, FT7: weight -1) and its back and bottom coils + (TP7, T9); each right-channel pair has its upper-front coil + (FTT7h, FTT8h) and its lower-back coil - (TTP9h, TTP10h). For the starred chirp version of this layout Murphy's demo video says instead that 'all of the coils on the left side of the head are positive' (murphy-shakti8-tv-chirpbi-amyl follows the video). Durations: the output pages and Murphy's demo video offer 40- and 60-min runs, and the video says 'most users seem to prefer the 40-minute session, 20 minutes of each of the signals seems to be enough' (in agreement, Murphy says, with some of the laboratory work); this file is that 40-min run. The 60-min run is presumably 30 + 30 min (not stated). The rotating Shiva God Helmet versions of this design are murphy-gh-hippbi-amyl-40min and -60min. The hippocampal 'LTP' signal is proprietary; it is approximated by 5 theta bursts of 4 biphasic pulses 9 ms apart (after the 4-pulse bursts of Larson & Lynch 1986), repeated at 5.4 Hz (the spectral peak the vendor gives for its LTP signal) and drawn on Shakti's standard 3-ms points (0.78 s; the burst count is a choice), then the standard 4-s silence. The amygdala 'burstx' signal is proprietary; it is approximated by the built-in accelerating burst (6 to 30 Hz) of 230 points at the standard 3-ms points (0.69 s, after the published 230-point burst-firing pattern), then the standard 4-s silence. Vendor: 'Be careful when setting up these sessions ... check and double-check' (here: check that the coils sit on the correct sides); the first phase may be unpleasant, and Skip goes to phase 2. Test the phase-2 signal on each side first with 10-min test sessions. The vendor reports headache or pressure in about 2% of users with the hippocampal signal (a figure it attributes to an earlier version of the technology); if so, lower the intensity by one third. For the God Helmet version of this design Murphy advises: anger or restlessness in phase 1 means Skip or Stop; anger or a 'racing mind' in phase 2 means stop and never reuse it; not for people prone to anger. The effects are vendor claims backed only by user reports. Independent double-blind tests found no field effect (Granqvist 2005; Gendle & McGrath 2012, the latter with the 8 Coil Shakti amygdala signal). Not for anyone with epilepsy or a seizure history, a psychiatric condition or medication, migraine or brain injury, or on drugs; this is not a treatment. Stop at once on fear or distress. Revised after a re-check of the vendor's two-phase pages (2026): 20 + 20 min instead of 30 + 30, eight separate coils as on the output pages instead of six with two shared between the phases, and polarity from the session photos instead of the general coil chart. Still approximate: the coil sites and both signal templates.
setting: Darkness and acoustic silence ('not just quiet'), at night; eyes closed or blindfolded; relax without meditating or falling asleep. A helper can press Skip or Stop so you stay in the dark. The vendor: 'You don't have to use sensory deprivation if you're looking for after-effects.'
schedule: Vendor: while trying sessions out, at most every 72 h; once you settle on a session, once a week; never on consecutive days. Sessions of an hour or more (the 60-min run) at most once every 3 weeks (weekly only if sessions have no effect).
